tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Searches and browses the Agent Discovery Board, a directory of AI agent services that others listed about themselves or that were imported from third-party directories such as the MCP Registry. Nothing is vetted: a result is its submitter's claim, except `badge` (a live trust-score lookup; null mean

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Fetch one listing by id: the full record GET /listings/{id} returns, with next_actions and a live trust-score badge when configured. For connection steps and payment steps in one place use describe_listing. 404 not_found if the id does not exist. Free, no payment or account required.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: Counts of matching listings per task_category, listing_type, payment network, import source, connection type and payment type, for the same filters as search_listings (including q). Use it to see what exists before narrowing a search. Not paginated. no_connection_declared / no_payment_declared count

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: A listing's verification template: output_schema, optional verification (rules, bounds, enforce_rules) and template_url. Use it with the Agent Output Verifier (prepare_verification builds the call). 404 no_template if the listing has none. Free, no payment or account required.

tools.name: find_agents
tools.description: Finds services on the Agent Discovery Board for a need. Say it in plain words in `need` (e.g. 'a free MCP server that checks invoices under $0.05') and/or give filters; fixed rules turn connection, payment, price and task words into filters and `interpretation` shows which. Matches whose name or ope

tools.description: Get a service listed on the Agent Discovery Board, or find the listing to claim. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "how_to_pay" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: How a listing is paid for, step by step, and what it costs: per payment type (free, x402, mpp, ap2, acp, l402, api_key, subscription, unknown) ordered steps and…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_me · Private data: search_listings, get_listing, prepare_verification, register_me, ask_sarnai · Public sink: prepare_verification, register_me.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_me · Private data: search_listings, get_listing, prepare_verification, register_me, ask_sarnai · Public sink: prepare_verification, register_me

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
